outputFormat: H.264 libx264 crf16 preset medium yuv420p, 30 fps CFR, no audio, 720x1560, +faststart
notes: 'speed' per clip is the effective average (source seconds / output seconds, excluding any freeze); exact per-section speeds are in speedSegments. Zoom rectangles are in SOURCE pixel space (720x1560) and every tStart/tEnd is output-clip time. Status bar shows 10:49-10:50 in the footage.

clips.description: App home screen, Single mode selected, title 'Contactless Fingerprint Auth' hero card with tech chips (YOLO, U2Net, ZeroDCE, MinutiaeNet, MCC) and AI Models / 1:N Auth / 1:1 Verify stats. The hero is static for about 1.7 s, then the page scrolls down to the Actions grid (Enroll, Authenticate, Verify, Pipeline, QC Pipeline) and settles. Ends on a settled home screen just before the tap into Enroll. Not a fully static 3 s hold: the first 1.7 s is static, the rest is the scroll to Actions.

clips.description: Home -> Pipeline tile -> Pipeline Visualizer -> Start Camera (5x/4x), then finger placement with guidance captions at 1x (source 74.0-77.0 s), capture, stage processing spinners (5x), and the stage cards at 1x: Quality Gate PASSED (Blur 158.7, Brightness 181.1, Glare None), Live Finger Detected 84.1%, Original (raw image with keyboard background), YOLO Crop (large finger crop), Preprocessed (black-and-white binarised ridge image), Minutiae (shows 'Not available' with a note that minutiae extraction and template generation run on the backend, not in this on-device visualiser).
